column1: # Optional table of series known under several titles (original / translated). Format: canonical title, TAB, other titles separated by « | ».
# Used ONLY to put the episodes of one series in ONE folder when several spellings are present in the same library (SeriesClassifier.plan with the built-in table):
# it never renames a lone file. Rules (checked by SeriesAliasesTest): a title appears once in the whole file; no year in a title (two series of the same name
# but different years, « The Flash » 1990 / 2014, « Doctor Who » 1963 / 2005, are never listed); no title shared by two series (« Les Revenants » is also
# « The Returned » for two different series: left out on purpose); only titles that are certain.
